role: Test-target fixture helpers that XCTFail at the call site and return a harmless stand-in instead of force-unwrapping: TestDate (date from components, adding, settingTime), TestUUID.fixed, and TestFixtureDefaults.timeDomain (all-zero TimeDomainMetrics).
types: TestDate: enum — non-trapping Calendar date builders
TestUUID: enum — non-trapping UUID literal parser
TestFixtureDefaults: enum — zero-valued stand-in analysis values
state: TestFixtureDefaults.timeDomain: static let TimeDomainMetrics with every field 0
toplevel: TestFixtureDefaults.timeDomain is a static stored TimeDomainMetrics initialiser with all zeros.

units.does: Builds a Date from DateComponents in the given calendar (default .current); on nil XCTFails at the caller's file/line and returns the 1970 epoch.

branches.effect: true: XCTFail + return epoch; false: return the date

units.does: Adds value×component to a date; on nil XCTFails at the caller and returns the input date unchanged.

branches.effect: true: XCTFail + return input date; false: return result

units.does: Sets hour/minute/second on a date; on nil XCTFails at the caller and returns the input date unchanged.

branches.effect: true: XCTFail + return input date; false: return result

units.does: Parses a UUID literal; on an invalid string XCTFails at the caller and returns a random UUID().

branches.effect: true: XCTFail + return random UUID; false: return parsed id
